newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE WEDNESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE WEDNESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reported moderate buyer inquiry.
Wk to Date - 66,100 Last Week - 109,300 Year Ago - 116,900
Sales reported on 15,500 slaughter steers and 5,600 heifers; 66,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 27,200 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
